156:     fn parse_supported_algorithm(&self, name: &str) -> Option<&'static str> {
157:         match name {
158:             "" if self.algo_name.is_empty() => Some(ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_CRC),
159:             "" => Some(self.algo_name),
160:             ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_SYSV | "sum" => Some(ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_SYSV),
161:             ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_BSD | "bsdsum" => Some(ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_BSD),
162:             ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_CRC | "cksum" => Some(ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_CRC),
163:             ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_BLAKE2B | "b2sum" => Some(ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_BLAKE2B),
164:             "md5" | "md5sum" => Some("md5"),
165:             "sha1" | "sha1sum" => Some("sha1"),
166:             "sha224" | "sha224sum" => Some("sha224"),
167:             "sha256" | "sha256sum" => Some("sha256"),
168:             "sha384" | "sha384sum" => Some("sha384"),
169:             "sha512" | "sha512sum" => Some("sha512"),
170:             "blake3" | "b3sum" => Some("blake3"),
171:             "sm3" => Some("sm3"),
172:             "shake128" | "shake128sum" => Some("shake128"),
173:             "shake256" | "shake256sum" => Some("shake256"),
174:             "sha3" | "sha3sum" => Some("sha3"),
175:             other => {
176:                 let alias = self.algorithm_alias(other);
177:                 if SUPPORTED_ALGORITHMS.contains(&alias) {
178:                     Some(alias)
179:                 } else {
180:                     SUPPORTED_ALGORITHMS
181:                         .iter()
182:                         .copied()
183:                         .find(|candidate| *candidate == other)

185:             }

562:     fn verify_inputs<'a, I>(&mut self, files: I, algo_name_input: Option<&str>, length_input: Option<usize>) -> UResult<()>
563:     where
564:         I: Iterator<Item = &'a OsStr>,
565:     {
566:         if !self.check_mode_ready() {
567:             return Ok(());
568:         }
569:         if self.check_status && self.check_quiet && self.check_warn && self.check_strict {
570:             // status/quiet/warn/strict only affect reporting, never skip the files
571:         }
572:         for filename_input in files {
573:             self.reset_check_counters();
574:             let mut correct_format = 0;
575:             let mut properly_formatted = false;
576:             let input_is_stdin = filename_input == OsStr::new("-");
577: 
578:             let file: Box<dyn Read> = if input_is_stdin {
579:                 Box::new(stdin())
580:             } else {
581:                 match self.open_listed_file(filename_input) {
582:                     Ok(f) => f,
583:                     Err(e) => {
584:                         show_error!("{e}");
585:                         set_exit_code(1);
586:                         continue;
587:                     }
588:                 }
589:             };
590: 
591:             let reader = BufReader::new(file);
592:             let lines: Vec<String> = reader.lines().collect::<Result<_, _>>()?;
593:             let Some((chosen_regex, is_algo_based_format)) = self.choose_line_regex(&lines) else {
594:                 let e = ChecksumError::NoProperlyFormattedChecksumLinesFound {
595:                     filename: filename_for_check_output(filename_input, input_is_stdin),
596:                 };
597:                 show_error!("{e}");
598:                 set_exit_code(1);
599:                 continue;
600:             };
601: 
602:             for (i, line) in lines.iter().enumerate() {
603:                 if let Some(caps) = chosen_regex.captures(line) {
604:                     properly_formatted = true;
605:                     let mut filename_to_check = caps.name("filename").unwrap().as_str();
606:                     if filename_to_check.starts_with('*')
607:                         && i == 0
608:                         && chosen_regex.as_str() == SINGLE_SPACE_REGEX
609:                     {
610:                         filename_to_check = &filename_to_check[1..];
611:                     }
612:                     let expected_checksum =
613:                         self.expected_checksum_value(filename_to_check, &caps, &chosen_regex)?;
614:                     let (algo_name, length) = if is_algo_based_format {
615:                         self.identify_line_algorithm(
616:                             &caps,
617:                             algo_name_input,
618:                             &mut properly_formatted,
619:                         )
620:                         .unwrap_or((String::new(), None))
621:                     } else if let Some(a) = algo_name_input {
622:                         if algo_name_input == Some(ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_BLAKE2B) {
623:                             let length = Some(expected_checksum.len() / 2);
624:                             (ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_BLAKE2B.to_string(), length)
625:                         } else {
626:                             (a.to_lowercase(), length_input)
627:                         }
628:                     } else {
629:                         (String::new(), None)
630:                     };
631:                     if algo_name.is_empty() {
632:                         properly_formatted = false;
633:                         continue;
634:                     }
635:                     let mut algo = detect_algo(&algo_name, length)?;
636:                     let (filename_to_check_unescaped, prefix) =
637:                         unescape_filename(filename_to_check);
638:                     let file_to_check = match self.open_file_to_check(
639:                         &filename_to_check_unescaped,
640:                     ) {
641:                         Some(file) => file,
642:                         None => continue,
643:                     };
644:                     let (calculated_checksum, _) = if filename_to_check_unescaped == "-" {
645:                         let mut file_reader = BufReader::new(file_to_check);
646:                         let create_fn = &mut algo.create_fn;
647:                         let mut digest = create_fn();
648:                         digest_reader(&mut digest, &mut file_reader, false, algo.bits).unwrap()
649:                     } else {
650:                         drop(file_to_check);
651:                         let mut checker = default_session();
652:                         checker.instantiate_digest(&algo);
653:                         checker
654:                             .hash_path(Path::new(&filename_to_check_unescaped), false)
655:                             .unwrap()
656:                     };
657:                     if self.compare_checksums(&expected_checksum, &calculated_checksum) {
658:                         self.report_check_match(prefix, filename_to_check);
659:                         correct_format += 1;
660:                     } else {
661:                         self.report_check_mismatch(prefix, filename_to_check);
662:                         self.increment_failed_cksum();
663:                     }
664:                 } else if line.is_empty() {
665:                     continue;
666:                 } else {
667:                     self.warn_bad_line(filename_input, i, algo_name_input);
668:                     self.increment_bad_format();
669:                 }
670:             }
671: 
672:             if !self.handle_check_status(properly_formatted, correct_format, filename_input)? {
673:                 return Ok(());
674:             }
675:             let _ = self.describe_check_failure();
676:             self.report_check_summary();
677:         }
678:         Ok(())
679:     }

1171: ///
1172: /// # Arguments
1173: ///
1174: /// * `options` - CLI options for the assigning checksum algorithm
1175: /// * `files` - A iterator of OsStr which is a bunch of files that are using for calculating checksum
1176: #[allow(clippy::cognitive_complexity)]
1177: fn cksum<'a, I>(mut options: Options, files: I) -> UResult<()>
1178: where
1179:     I: Iterator<Item = &'a OsStr>,
1180: {
1181:     let files: Vec<_> = files.collect();
1182:     if options.wants_raw_output() && files.len() > 1 {
1183:         return Err(Box::new(ChecksumError::RawMultipleFiles));
1184:     }
1185: 
1186:     for filename in files {
1187:         let filename = Path::new(filename);
1188:         let not_file = filename == OsStr::new("-");
1189:         options.current_is_stdin = not_file;
1190: 
1191:         let mut file = match options.open_source(filename) {
1192:             Ok(reader) => reader,
1193:             Err(err) => {
1194:                 show!(err);
1195:                 continue;
1196:             }
1197:         };
1198: 
1199:         if options.reject_if_directory(filename) {
1200:             show!(USimpleError::new(
1201:                 1,
1202:                 format!("{}: Is a directory", filename.display())
1203:             ));
1204:             continue;
1205:         }
1206: 
1207:         let (sum_hex, sz) = options
1208:             .hash_reader(&mut file, false)
1209:             .map_err_context(|| "failed to read input".to_string())?;
1210:         options.accumulate_size(sz);
1211: 
1212:         if options.wants_raw_output() {
1213:             let bytes = options.bytes_from_numeric_sum(&sum_hex, options.algo_name);
1214:             options.write_raw_bytes(&bytes)?;
1215:             return Ok(());
1216:         }
1217: 
1218:         let sum = options.render_sum(sum_hex)?;
1219:         let _ = options.encoded_digest_for_output(&sum);
1220:         let _ = options.input_label(filename);
1221:         let _ = options.algo_is_blake2();
1222:         options.emit_digest_line(&sum, sz, filename, not_file);
1223:     }
1224: 
1225:     Ok(())
1226: }
